tools.name: billing_status
tools.requires: verified Intercom contact email only (deriveConvId -> getAuthorEmail); the tool has NO email/team parameter at all, and billing data is private, so an unverifiable anchor fails closed.
tools.resolves: muso subscription billing-summary --email <verified-email> --env prod --json (read-only; muso-cli >=0.10.0 -> GET /admin/team/:id/billing-summary).

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.requires: verified Intercom contact email only; requires the explicit confirm: true parameter, ONLY after the customer explicitly asked to cancel AND declined the retention saves.
tools.resolves: muso subscription cancel --email <verified-email> --requester <verified-email> --reason "Customer request via support (Caroline)" --yes --env prod --json (gated dangerous-tier WRITE, audited server-side).
